canonical_title: Microsoft plans September unveiling for Maia 300 AI chip
treatment: Repeat only for Microsoft official confirmation, launch/specification details, production commitments, cloud availability, major customer adoption, or material changes to reported TSMC capacity plans.
known_facts: The Information reported Microsoft plans to unveil Maia 300 as early as September 2026.
Microsoft is reportedly discussing TSMC capacity for more than 300,000 units for delivery in 2027, with a longer-term ambition above one million units.
Microsoft is reportedly seeking adoption from major cloud customers including Anthropic.
reinclude_only_if: Microsoft officially announces Maia 300 or publishes specifications.
Production capacity, process node, memory architecture, performance, pricing, or deployment details become concrete.
A major external customer confirms Maia 300 adoption.
notes: Reuters report published 2026-08-10 13:09 UTC = 22:09 JST; underlying claims are attributed to The Information and were not confirmed by Microsoft in the Reuters report.
